020package com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.checks.javadoc;
021
022import java.util.ArrayList;
023import java.util.Arrays;
024import java.util.List;
025
026import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.StatelessCheck;
027import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.api.DetailNode;
028import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.api.JavadocCommentsTokenTypes;
029import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.utils.CommonUtil;
030import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.utils.JavadocUtil;
031
032/**
033 * <div>
034 * Checks that one blank line before the block tag if it is present in Javadoc.
035 * </div>
036 *
037 * @since 8.36
038 */
039@StatelessCheck
040public class RequireEmptyLineBeforeBlockTagGroupCheck extends AbstractJavadocCheck {
041
042    /**
043     * The key in "messages.properties" for the message that describes a tag in javadoc
044     * requiring an empty line before it.
045     */
046    public static final String MSG_JAVADOC_TAG_LINE_BEFORE = "javadoc.tag.line.before";
047
048    /**
049     * Case when space separates the tag and the asterisk like in the below example.
050     * <pre>
051     *  /**
052     *   * &#64;param noSpace there is no space here
053     * </pre>
054     */
055    private static final List<Integer> ONLY_TAG_VARIATION_1 = Arrays.asList(
056            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.TEXT,
057            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.LEADING_ASTERISK,
058            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.NEWLINE);
059
060    /**
061     * Case when no space separates the tag and the asterisk like in the below example.
062     * <pre>
063     *  /**
064     *   *&#64;param noSpace there is no space here
065     * </pre>
066     */
067    private static final List<Integer> ONLY_TAG_VARIATION_2 = Arrays.asList(
068            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.LEADING_ASTERISK,
069            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.NEWLINE);
070
071    /**
072     * Case when space separates the tag and multiple asterisks like in the below example.
073     * <pre>
074     *  /**
075     *   &#42;&#42; &#64;param noSpace there is no space here
076     * </pre>
077     */
078    private static final List<Integer> ONLY_TAG_VARIATION_3 = Arrays.asList(
079            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.TEXT,
080            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.LEADING_ASTERISKS,
081            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.NEWLINE);
082
083    /**
084     * Case when no space separates the tag and multiple asterisks like in the below example.
085     * <pre>
086     *  /**
087     *   &#42;&#42;&#64;param noSpace there is no space here
088     * </pre>
089     */
090    private static final List<Integer> ONLY_TAG_VARIATION_4 = Arrays.asList(
091            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.LEADING_ASTERISKS,
092            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.NEWLINE);
093
094    /**
095     * Case when one extra asterisk is in the javadoc start like in the below example.
096     * <pre>
097     *  /&#42;&#42;&#42;
098     *   &#42; &#64;param noSpace there is no space here
099     * </pre>
100     */
101    private static final List<Integer> ONLY_TAG_VARIATION_5 = Arrays.asList(
102            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.TEXT,
103            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.LEADING_ASTERISK,
104            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.NEWLINE,
105            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.LEADING_ASTERISK);
106
107    /**
108     * Case when a boxed javadoc has only a block tag like in the below example.
109     * <pre>
110     *  /&#42;&#42;&#42;&#42;&#42;&#42;&#42;&#42;&#42;
111     *   &#42;&#42;&#42; &#64;param noSpace there is no space here
112     * </pre>
113     */
114    private static final List<Integer> ONLY_TAG_VARIATION_6 = Arrays.asList(
115            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.TEXT,
116            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.LEADING_ASTERISKS,
117            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.NEWLINE,
118            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.LEADING_ASTERISKS);
119
120    /**
121     * Creates a new {@code RequireEmptyLineBeforeBlockTagGroupCheck} instance.
122     */
123    public RequireEmptyLineBeforeBlockTagGroupCheck() {
124        // no code by default
125    }
126
127    /**
128     * Returns only javadoc tags so visitJavadocToken only receives javadoc tags.
129     *
130     * @return only javadoc tags.
131     */
132    @Override
133    public int[] getDefaultJavadocTokens() {
134        return new int[] {
135            JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.JAVADOC_BLOCK_TAG,
136        };
137    }
138
139    @Override
140    public int[] getRequiredJavadocTokens() {
141        return getAcceptableJavadocTokens();
142    }
143
144    /**
145     * Logs when there is no empty line before the tag.
146     *
147     * @param tagNode the at tag node to check for an empty space before it.
148     */
149    @Override
150    public void visitJavadocToken(DetailNode tagNode) {
151        // No need to filter token because overridden getDefaultJavadocTokens ensures that we only
152        // receive JAVADOC_BLOCK_TAG DetailNode.
153        if (!isAnotherTagBefore(tagNode)
154                && !isOnlyTagInWholeJavadoc(tagNode)
155                && hasInsufficientConsecutiveNewlines(tagNode)) {
156            final String tagName = JavadocUtil.getTagName(tagNode);
157            log(tagNode.getLineNumber(),
158                    MSG_JAVADOC_TAG_LINE_BEFORE,
159                    "@" + tagName);
160        }
161    }
162
163    /**
164     * Returns true when there is a javadoc tag before the provided tagNode.
165     *
166     * @param tagNode the javadoc tag node, to look for more tags before it.
167     * @return true when there is a javadoc tag before the provided tagNode.
168     */
169    private static boolean isAnotherTagBefore(DetailNode tagNode) {
170        boolean found = false;
171        DetailNode currentNode = tagNode.getPreviousSibling();
172        while (currentNode != null) {
173            if (currentNode.getType() == JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.JAVADOC_BLOCK_TAG) {
174                found = true;
175                break;
176            }
177            currentNode = currentNode.getPreviousSibling();
178        }
179        return found;
180    }
181
182    /**
183     * Returns true when there are is only whitespace and asterisks before the provided tagNode.
184     * When javadoc has only a javadoc tag like {@literal @} in it, the JAVADOC_TAG in a JAVADOC
185     * detail node will always have 2 or 3 siblings before it. The parse tree looks like:
186     * <pre>
187     * JAVADOC_CONTENT[3x0]
188     * |--NEWLINE[3x0] : [\n]
189     * |--LEADING_ASTERISK[4x1] : [*]
190     * |--TEXT[4x2] : [ ]
191     * |--JAVADOC_BLOCK_TAG[4x3] : [@param T The bar.\n ]
192     * </pre>
193     * Or it can also look like:
194     * <pre>
195     * JAVADOC_CONTENT[3x0]
196     * |--NEWLINE[3x0] : [\n]
197     * |--LEADING_ASTERISK[4x1] : [*]
198     * |--JAVADOC_BLOCK_TAG[4x3] : [@param T The bar.\n ]
199     * </pre>
200     * We do not include the variation
201     * <pre>
202     *  /**&#64;param noSpace there is no space here
203     * </pre>
204     * which results in the tree
205     * <pre>
206     * JAVADOC_CONTENT[3x0]
207     * |--JAVADOC_BLOCK_TAG[4x3] : [@param noSpace there is no space here\n ]
208     * </pre>
209     * because this one is invalid. We must recommend placing a blank line to separate &#64;param
210     * from the first javadoc asterisks.
211     *
212     * @param tagNode the at tag node to check if there is nothing before it
213     * @return true if there is no text before the tagNode
214     */
215    @SuppressWarnings("InvalidInlineTag")
216    private static boolean isOnlyTagInWholeJavadoc(DetailNode tagNode) {
217        final List<Integer> previousNodeTypes = new ArrayList<>();
218        DetailNode currentNode = tagNode.getPreviousSibling();
219
220        while (currentNode != null) {
221            previousNodeTypes.add(currentNode.getType());
222            currentNode = currentNode.getPreviousSibling();
223        }
224        return ONLY_TAG_VARIATION_1.equals(previousNodeTypes)
225                || ONLY_TAG_VARIATION_2.equals(previousNodeTypes)
226                || ONLY_TAG_VARIATION_3.equals(previousNodeTypes)
227                || ONLY_TAG_VARIATION_4.equals(previousNodeTypes)
228                || ONLY_TAG_VARIATION_5.equals(previousNodeTypes)
229                || ONLY_TAG_VARIATION_6.equals(previousNodeTypes);
230    }
231
232    /**
233     * Returns true when there are not enough empty lines before the provided tagNode.
234     *
235     * <p>Iterates through the previous siblings of the tagNode looking for empty lines until
236     * there are no more siblings or it hits something other than asterisk, whitespace or newline.
237     * If it finds at least one empty line, return true. Return false otherwise.</p>
238     *
239     * @param tagNode the tagNode to check if there are sufficient empty lines before it.
240     * @return true if there are not enough empty lines before the tagNode.
241     */
242    private static boolean hasInsufficientConsecutiveNewlines(DetailNode tagNode) {
243        int count = 0;
244        DetailNode currentNode = tagNode.getPreviousSibling();
245        while (currentNode != null
246                && (CommonUtil.isBlank(currentNode.getText())
247                || isLeadingAsterisk(currentNode))) {
248            if (currentNode.getType() == JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.NEWLINE) {
249                count++;
250            }
251            currentNode = currentNode.getPreviousSibling();
252        }
253
254        return count <= 1;
255    }
256
257    /**
258     * Checks if current node is leading asterisk.
259     *
260     * @param detailNode the node to check.
261     * @return true when token is a leading asterisk.
262     */
263    private static boolean isLeadingAsterisk(DetailNode detailNode) {
264        return detailNode.getType() == JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.LEADING_ASTERISK
265                || detailNode.getType() == JavadocCommentsTokenTypes.LEADING_ASTERISKS;
266    }
267
268}
